title: Adamah Summer Internship
commitment: 13 weeks (May 26 – Aug 22, with 1-week break in July); 40 hours work per week
cost_text: $3,000 scholarship upon completion; tuition coverage for one summer workshop; room and board included
how_to_join: Application period Jan 1 – Feb 15, 2026; interns announced Mar 1, 2026. Applications are currently closed.
source_quote: We are offering two summer internship positions for 2026 ... Interns will gain experience running electric, gas-reduction, raku, and wood kilns.
evidence_sentence: The summer internship includes firing experience in wood, gas-reduction, raku, and salt kilns, plus a week-long included workshop.
evidence_quote: Interns will gain experience running electric, gas-reduction, raku, and wood kilns. Depending on interest and time, interns will get to experience firing their own work multiple times in any of the mentioned firing methods. Interns will participate in the Salt Fire (our catenary chamber of the Anagama Kiln).
summary: A 13-week summer residency (May 26 – Aug 22, 2026, with 1-week break) providing hands-on experience in wood, gas-reduction, raku, and salt firings. Interns receive $3,000 scholarship, workshop tuition coverage, lodging, meals, studio access, and clay. Applications were due Feb 15, 2026.
